scope: Read-only recheck of 13 image holds: 11 Pluck CMS refs, one Yunucms ref, one Sifudi blank image reference. No repository edits; no PoCs, scanners, payloads, or sample targets executed/accessed.

findings.pluck: The exact same-article public mirror exists at the source page URL and exposes exact rId25/rId26/rId29/rId30/rId31/rId32/rId34/rId35/rId37/rId38/rId39 attachment paths. Every corresponding current media request returned HTTP 200 text/html error content (836-byte generic error or the retained 469-byte 404 HTML), never image bytes. No screenshot can be restored from these URLs. The mirror article context confirms these are screenshot positions but not their pixel content.
findings.yunucms: The exact same-article public mirror maps rId26.png, rId27.png, rId28.png and rId29.shtml in sequence. Existing first three captures are outside the hold; the final rId29.shtml link is missing in the mirror too and returns HTML error content. No exact final image is available.
findings.sifudi: Recorded Yuque source page responds with HTML title “输入密码 · 语雀” and enable_password=true; article content/attachments are unavailable. The archived Markdown target is ![]() with no filename. Adjacent Threekiii/PeiQi article screenshots are separate article records and cannot be mapped to this blank Yuque attachment by subject similarity.
findings.decision: All 13 image holds remain accurate. No proven exact same-article attachment blob exists in the checked source paths; no replacement is justified.
